title: Getting Bob Lazar onto Joe Rogan's show by speakerphone call during a Michigan screening trip

tellings.quote: Bob said I go, "Bob, look, George and I are coming out because we have a a premiere or a screening um in Michigan.

plain: In 2019, a man named Jeremy Corbell says, he helped get Bob Lazar, who claims he once worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site, onto the show of the podcaster Joe Rogan through a speakerphone call. Corbell tells Michels he called Lazar and said that he and George Knapp, who was travelling with him, were coming out for a screening in Michigan, and the plan to bring Lazar on Rogan's show grew from that trip. He tells it as part of his own role in bringing Lazar's story to a wide audience.
